caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest on four legs. The chest is rectangular in shape with visible dovetail joints at the corners, and features a reddish-brown wood grain texture throughout. The front of the chest includes a keyhole at the top center and a horizontal drawer below, which has two metal pull handles, one on each side. The drawer is set within a base that has a decorative scalloped edge. The legs of the chest are cabriole-style, curving outward and then inward, with claw-and-ball feet. The background is plain and beige in color, and there are no additional objects or decorations present.
title: Cellaret
